title: Waldorf Astoria Los Cabos Pedregal — Walton Street Capital Mexico
text: Waldorf Astoria Los Cabos Pedregal. Fue adquirido por filiales de Walton Street Capital México. Affiliates of Walton Street Capital Mexico, the owner at Hilton debut. PropCo legal title holder remains unresolved. Hilton is the brand operator path — not the hotel owner.
